text.description:
{Rune of Arcane Mastery}

Stack equipped with this artifact has a bonus of +2 to casts and can cast the following spells: Expert Bless, Expert Blind, Expert Slow.
text.event: You help a runesmith by securing a cargo of ore. For this help, he rewards you with a magic rune.
text.name: Rune of Arcane Mastery
